placements.why: Explicit instructions to forget decisions and remove migration knowledge introduce the category of organizational knowledge governance and memory management.
placements.title: Governing Organizational Memory and Data Retention
placements.frame: How does the organization establish governance policies for retaining, modifying, or expunging architectural and decision history?

placements.title: Authoritative Purging of Historical Decisions and Migrations
placements.frame: How are explicit directives to forget decisions and purge technical migration records enacted and tracked?
placements.why: Both expressions are direct authoritative commands instructing the expungement and removal of specific decision and technical migration records from the retained knowledge base.
